chunks: And al-Ridha, peace be upon him, said:
Temporary marriage (mut'ah) is not lawful except for one who understands it, and it is forbidden for one who is ignorant of it.

key_terms.عَرَفَهَا: understood it or had knowledge of it

ai.seo_question: When is mut'ah lawful or forbidden according to Imam al-Ridha عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam al-Ridha عليه السلام states a legal ruling concerning mut'ah, restricting its lawfulness to one who knows and understands it. The report emphasizes that ignorance of its rules and reality makes engaging in it forbidden.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4584 - Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (as) said:
"Temporary marriage (Mutah) is not lawful except for one who understands it, and it is forbidden for one who is ignorant of it."
